fusions.name: Ballast Sack
fusions.desc: Swings a sack of packed earth on the end of the haft for 14 damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tarp Crack
fusions.desc: Whips a dirt-laden groundsheet around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 35% chance to leave each one [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sandbag Parapet
fusions.desc: Stacks filled sacks in front of you as a barrier that absorbs 24 damage for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Mud and Lint
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you pack the wound with clay and bind it, regaining 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
